messages.dark: It's black as the inside of a boot.

description.text: The end stall waits for its owner.

upstream.say: The wash narrows to a crack in the rock a little way upstream. Nothing bigger than a lizard could get through.

downstream.say: Downstream the wash runs out into open desert. You'd need a horse for that.

peg.name: peg
peg.description: A wooden peg driven into the stable wall.

lariat.name: lariat
lariat.description: Thirty feet of stiff grass rope with a honda knot at one end.

stalls.name: stalls
stalls.description: A row of stalls. The one at the end stands empty.

desk.name: desk
desk.description: A scarred desk, its top more cigarette burn than wood.

jar.name: glass jar
jar.description: A glass jar with a tin lid.

sugar.name: sugar lumps
sugar.description: A handful of brown sugar lumps.

poster.name: poster
poster.description: A notice tacked to the wall, in fresh ink.

stones.name: white stones
stones.description: Smooth white stones, scattered where the water used to run.

buildings.name: false-fronted buildings
buildings.description: Plank buildings with tall square fronts nailed on to make them look grander than they are. Most are shut against the heat.

sun.name: sun
sun.description: Too bright to look at, and a long way yet from going down.

trail.name: trail
trail.description: A path beaten into the bank by hooves and boots, steep enough that you lean back going down.

hay.name: hay
hay.description: Loose hay underfoot, and the warm, sour smell of it everywhere.

stable-door.name: stable door
stable-door.description: Wide double doors, propped open to let some air through.

stove.name: stove
stove.description: A squat iron stove, cold since spring.

creek-bed.name: creek bed
creek-bed.description: Clay baked into plates that curl at the edges. The banks crumble when you touch them.

mesquite.name: mesquite
mesquite.description: Thorny scrub, its roots reaching down further than the creek ever did.

walls.name: walls
walls.description: Rough planks, shrunk by the heat until daylight shows through the gaps.
